Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add Sprint 1 core tools: fetch_url, grep_search, edit_file, token counting

New tools:
- fetch_url: Fetch and extract readable content from URLs with HTML to
  markdown conversion, content type detection, and size limits
- grep_search: Regex search across codebase with include/exclude patterns,
  context lines, and smart defaults \(excludes .git, node_modules, binaries\)
- edit_file: Surgical text replacement with occurrence selection
- insert_lines: Insert content at specific line numbers
- delete_lines: Remove line ranges from files

Token counting module:
- Token estimation using ~4 chars/token heuristic
- Usage tracking for prompt, completion, and total tokens
- Cost estimation with pricing presets for common models
- Session statistics with formatted summaries

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(gh pr create --base develop --head feature/sprint-1-core-tools --title "Sprint 1: Core Tools Implementation" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary

Implements Sprint 1 from the roadmap - Core Completeness features:

### New Tools
- **`fetch_url`** - Fetch and extract readable content from URLs with HTML to markdown conversion
- **`grep_search`** - Regex search across codebase with include/exclude patterns and context lines
- **`edit_file`** - Surgical text replacement with occurrence selection
- **`insert_lines`** - Insert content at specific line numbers
- **`delete_lines`** - Remove line ranges from files

### Token Counting Module
- Token estimation using ~4 chars/token heuristic
- Usage tracking for prompt, completion, and total tokens
- Cost estimation with pricing presets for common models
- Session statistics with formatted summaries

### Dependencies
- Added `golang.org/x/net/html` for HTML parsing

## Test plan
- [ ] Build project with `make build`
- [ ] Verify `fetch_url` works with HTML pages
- [ ] Verify `grep_search` finds patterns in codebase
- [ ] Verify `edit_file` replaces text correctly
- [ ] Verify token counting estimates are reasonable

EOF
